facts.fact: 1952 年 1 月，暴风雨夜，Clay Lockhart 的哭声沿苏格兰外赫布里底海岸传出半英里
facts.anchor: Clay Lockhart’s cries echoed for half a mile up the rain-drowned coastline

facts.fact: 他推开橡木门冲进风暴，怀里抱着一具身体
facts.anchor: a body slumped and weighted in his arms

facts.fact: 他把死者放进自家临海地块的土里，埋法与十年前葬父母相同
facts.anchor: just as he’d done with his parents a decade earlier

facts.fact: 未足月的双胞胎只由两块小石头代替，他把它们塞在妻子肋边
facts.anchor: They were merely stones, tiny as garden squash, not yet ripe.

facts.fact: 那一夜地面裂开，房子连同四公顷土地脱离大陆，漂进大西洋
facts.anchor: to crack free of the mainland and drift out into the Atlantic

facts.fact: 邻居 Neil 望向海面，成为目击者
facts.anchor: Neil lifted his eyes and peered out at the sea

facts.fact: 全书最后一个名字是 Eleanor Mills，她的命途将在一个风雨夜偏航
facts.anchor: A girl named Eleanor Mills, whose life would veer off course on a rainy, tempest night.

facts.fact: 民间说法认定他后来跳崖自尽，岛本身被当作诅咒与传说
facts.anchor: Clay Lockhart, in his despair, likely flung himself over the cliff’s edge that night.
